properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js ships SHA-1/SHA-2 hash implementations in the bundle. The application's own SHA-2 usage goes through bcrypto (e.g. airdrop file checksums), not hash.js — no direct call site found in app code, but the package's presence is what this inventory records.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The weak single-round MD5 KDF ships in the renderer's polyfilled crypto stack via the webpack node-polyfill chain; the application's own crypto (bcrypto/hsd) does not import evp_bytestokey directly. Dependency inventory entry — presence is what matters here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.4 ships ECDSA implementations in the build (transitive dependency). The application itself signs and verifies with bcrypto's secp256k1 module instead — no direct call site found in app code; presence of the dependency is what this inventory records.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BLAKE2b is the Handshake protocol's default hash (name hashing, covenant hashing, sighash, Merkle commitments). These sites build the airdrop Merkle commitments and hash name-claim data — protocol-fixed by the Handshake chain and the airdrop tree format; not a PQ deadline item (Grover gives only a square-root speedup against 256-bit digests). Changeable only via protocol change.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hs-airdrop claim protocol: HKDF-SHA256 expands each subtree seed into the synthetic leaf hashes so the claimant can prove the generation script was honest (diffSubtree filters them out). Protocol-fixed by the airdrop tree format; SHA-256 base is Grover-weakened but adequate for this purpose.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All wallet-relevant outbound HTTPS: HIP-2 address lookups, CoinGecko price feed, GitHub release checks, ShakeDEX auction API (list/fee-info). Runtime is Electron 22.0.3 (devDependency), which bundles Node 16.17/Chromium 108 with OpenSSL 1.1.1 — TLS 1.3 defaults negotiate X25519, TLS 1.2 ECDHE; no post-quantum hybrid group exists anywhere in this runtime, so all of this traffic is harvest-now-decrypt-later. Node version "unknown" in the object is resolvable from package.json: electron 22.0.3. Cha

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: 160-bit CSPRNG-generated API keys for the local hsd node RPC: connections/service.js:26 first-run generation, node/service.js:54 and wallet/service.js:272 regeneration, APIKeyModal.js:43 UI generation. Secure randomness from Node's crypto module — no weakness; recorded as key-material generation (these keys gate RPC access to the wallet node).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dev-only: selfsigned generates the webpack-dev-server's self-signed HTTPS certificate for local development. It is not part of the shipped production runtime and has no call site in app code — recorded as a declared dependency that ships in the dev toolchain. Its self-signed X.509 output would never validate against a WebPKI root, which is fine for localhost dev use.
